[[EXPERIMENT_TITLE]] - ÄKTA Chromatography Run Report

1. Experiment Information

Experiment ID: [[EXPERIMENT_ID]]

Process ID: [[PROCESS_ID]]

2. Start & End Date

Start Date: [[EXPERIMENT_DATE]]

Report / End Date: [[REPORT_DATE]]

3. Methods

3.1 Overview of Automated Workflow
  • The experiment was performed on an ÄKTA Pure chromatography system controlled by an automated workflow.
  • The workflow began with a manual pause step to allow the operator to fill the sample loop ("Manually fill sample loop").
  • After the loop was filled, the run was resumed and the automated ÄKTA protocol was started.
  • Sample detection signals recorded during the run included UV (uv1) and conductivity (cond).
  • Sample data were collected with a sampling time of 1 second.
3.2 Chromatography Run Parameters (Available Placeholders)

The following run parameters are available as placeholders in this template:

Parameter Placeholder Description
Process ID [[PROCESS_ID]] Identifier of the automated chromatography process / workflow.
Equilibration duration [[EQUILIBRATION_DURATION]] Time for column equilibration before sample loading.
Equilibration flow rate [[EQUILIBRATION_FLOW_RATE]] Flow rate used during column equilibration.
Load/inject duration [[LOAD_INJECT_DURATION]] Total time used for loading and/or injecting the sample.
Load/inject flow rate [[LOAD_INJECT_FLOW_RATE]] Flow rate used during sample loading/injection.
Elution gradient duration [[ELUTE_GRADIENT_DURATION]] Total duration of the elution gradient.
Elution gradient start [[ELUTE_GRADIENT_GRADIENT_START]] Starting composition of the elution gradient (e.g. %B).
Elution gradient end [[ELUTE_GRADIENT_GRADIENT_END]] Final composition of the elution gradient (e.g. %B).
Wash duration [[WASH_DURATION]] Duration of the post-elution wash step.
Wash flow rate [[WASH_FLOW_RATE]] Flow rate used during the wash step.
CIP duration [[CIP_DURATION]] Overall duration of the main CIP (clean-in-place) step.
CIP 2 hold duration [[CIP_2_HOLD_DURATION]] Hold time during the second CIP phase.
CIP 3 duration [[CIP_3_DURATION]] Duration of the third CIP phase.
CIP 4 duration [[CIP_4_DURATION]] Duration of the fourth CIP phase.
CIP 5 duration [[CIP_5_DURATION]] Duration of the fifth CIP phase.

4. Results

4.1 Chromatogram
[[PLOT_1]]

Figure 1: ÄKTA chromatogram (UV and conductivity signals over time/volume) for process [[PROCESS_ID]]. The chromatogram image file (e.g. chromatogram_{ID}.png) should be uploaded to eLabFTW and its download URL inserted in place of [[PLOT_1]].

  • Review peak shape, retention times, and resolution between peaks.
  • Compare UV (uv1) and conductivity (cond) traces to verify expected column behavior.
  • Verify that equilibration, loading, wash, elution, and CIP segments correspond to the programmed parameters listed above.
